[[Norman]] is a [[mercenary registrar]] who enables players to register [[mercenary heroes]].

==Locations==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Eye of the North (outpost)}}

==Dialogue==
{{:Mercenary registrar/dialogue}}

==Mercenary Hero Registration==
[[File:Mercenary Hero registration window.jpg|300px|thumb|right|Appearance of the window with three slots unlocked and two mercenary heroes created. The selected slot is currently empty.]]
Selecting the ''"This sounds awesome! Sign me up!"'' option from his dialogue will open the mercenary hero registration window. A personality may be selected for the mercenary; see [[Mercenary Hero/Dialogue]] for a list of personality types.

==Trivia==
* His initial dialogue is a reference to a famed advert for [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=owGykVbfgUE Old Spice body wash].
* Norman was added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110303|March 3rd 2011 update]].
